changelog: Stage 4 Zero Browser Database: Completely eliminated database connection strings, database clients, and direct SQL queries from the frontend client bundle.
Removed Browser Database Drivers: Deleted src/lib/neonClient.ts, src/lib/db.ts, and removed Dexie IndexedDB client fallback from client code.
Server-Authoritative Notifications: Migrated NotificationContext to use authenticated /api/notifications serverless endpoint for fetching, marking read, and broadcasting notifications.
Server-Only Database Credentials: Removed VITE_NEON_DATABASE_URL from client environment definitions, docs, and configurations; PostgreSQL is accessed strictly via server-side DATABASE_URL.
Streamlined Settings & Data Management: Replaced offline Dexie sync and cache wipe controls with a production-grade Data Snapshots & Recovery interface powered by serverless atomic transactions.
